title: actions: run_action and the REST action run door still answer an error after an action's write lands when the parent summary recompute fails, so the caller runs the action again
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28844 dev (os-dev-report 6566763583, `out_of_scope_findings`, class b), filed by this seat as a follow-up card. Filed by `domain:server` seat 5. Graded by this seat: p2, the same class as #28661 / #28782 / #28844 (a write that landed is answered as a failure, so the caller retries it), under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).

Reach: any caller of a declarative action (MCP `run_action`, the REST action run door, the Console action button) whose write body touches an object that feeds a summary roll-up, when the parent recompute fails after the write is stored.
Reader who acts: a `domain:server` seat (`packages/runtime`, then `packages/mcp` / `packages/rest`).

## What happens

`invokeBusinessAction` in `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` already attaches each write step's answer to the `ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE` refusal through #28781's carrier (`withEarnedAnswer`), but that answer is the write's data answer, not the action's own result. No action door reads `earnedAnswerOf`, so an action whose write was stored still answers an error. A caller (an agent above all) reads "the action failed" and runs it again, repeating every side effect.

After PR #28854 (#28844) the MCP `create_record`, `update_record` and `delete_record` tools answer a landed write as the write it is; `run_action` is the remaining MCP write tool with the gap.

## Wanted

- Decide what an action that landed under a failing roll-up answers: its own result (composed as if the recompute had succeeded) with the stale column logged, as the write tools do. ⛔ No new error code, result member or shape unless a ruling says so.
- The action doors (MCP `run_action`, the REST run door) relay that answer; a refusal raised before any write answers exactly as before.
- Name the multi-step case: an action whose second write step runs after a first step's recompute failure. Whether the action keeps going or stops is part of the ruling, and the order must state it.
- One test per door, red first, with ablations.

Blocked-by: none (PR #28854 is landing; this card only reuses the carrier already on `main`).

Dedupe: searched `run_action summary recompute` and `action ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE`; only #28844. **New.**

Links back: #28844, PR #28854, #28782, PR #28843, #28661, PR #28781.
